portabel-utomhusgrill.title: Portable Outdoor BBQ – Small & Large Model
portabel-utomhusgrill.descriptionHtml:
Enjoy your barbecued favourites wherever you are!
Our portable outdoor BBQ is perfect for camping, picnics, the beach or the balcony. The compact design makes it easy to carry, while the sturdy steel construction delivers long-lasting durability and even heat distribution.

Available in two sizes to suit your needs:

  • Large model: 43 cm x 29 cm x 23 cm

  • Small model: 35 cm x 27 cm x 20 cm

Both sizes are easy to assemble and use – ready to barbecue in just a few minutes.

Features:

  • Portable design – perfect for day trips, camping & the balcony

  • Sturdy steel construction

  • Easy to assemble, use and clean

  • Choose between the small and large model

  • Takes charcoal for that classic BBQ flavour

Why choose a portable BBQ?

A portable BBQ gives you the freedom to barbecue whenever and wherever you like. It's easy to carry, quick to set up and takes up very little space when not in use. Perfect if you're not willing to miss out on barbecued food – at home, on the road or out in nature.

seo.title: Portable Outdoor BBQ – Small & Large | The BBQ Clinic
seo.description: Compact portable charcoal BBQ for camping, beach days and balconies. Two sizes, sturdy steel build and quick set-up. BBQ accessories Australia.
